title: Sample: Cells in 60 Seconds
intro: Cells in sixty seconds. Here's what will be on the exam.

scenes.heading: Mitochondria
scenes.narration: Mitochondria make ATP, the energy cells spend. They do it through cellular respiration, and they even carry their own small loop of DNA.

scenes.heading: Cell membrane
scenes.narration: The membrane is a phospholipid bilayer. Water-loving heads face out, tails hide inside, and proteins carry things across.

scenes.heading: Ribosomes
scenes.narration: Ribosomes build proteins by reading messenger RNA, one codon at a time.
